What's New in ZenithGuard

v2.2.0

Version 2.4.0 - The Precision Update

Gist Rules - Always Latest

We've improved the dynamic rule synchronization. ZenithGuard now automatically detects and migrates to "Always Latest" Gist URLs, ensuring your trackers and YouTube rules are always up-to-the-minute without pinning to old versions.

Redundancy Cleanup

The "Subscriptions" tab is now cleaner! We've removed the redundant manual EasyList entry as it's now handled directly by our "Built-in" ruleset architecture, saving you memory and loading time.

Zombie Script Protection

Improved robustness for long-lived pages like YouTube Live Streams. Legacy scripts now gracefully retire when the extension is updated, preventing "Context Invalidated" console errors and keeping your browser console clean.

Pro Codebase Audit

A total audit of all 23 active modules. We've removed deprecated logic and optimized internal import flows for maximum performance and future-proofing.
